definitions.full: H992. botnim בָּטְנִים noun [masculine] plural pistachio, an oval nut (compare Assyrian bu‰nu COT Gloss & Schr MBAK 1881, 419 , Aramaic בּוּטְנָא , , Arabic ; on Punic Βουτνούμ Blau ZMG 1873, 527 ) = pistacia terebinthus Rob BR i. 208, ii. 222 , Post PEF Oct. 1888, 218, No. 214 f; Tr. Vict. Inst. xxii. 271 etc. pist. vera Löw No. 44 ); Gen 43:11 one of the articles carried from Canaan to Egypt by sons of Jacob as present to Joseph; still a delicacy in Egypt and Syria, compare Wetzst in Löw p.420 .
